# Supplementary Information

Automatically generated from `outputs/tables/*.csv`, produced by `R6G_Raman_DFT_Validation.ipynb`. Every table below is the complete, reproducible output of that notebook -- large tables (e.g. all 186 DFT modes, all pooled-spectrum statistics) are truncated for display here (first/last 20 rows) but the full CSV/XLSX files are in `outputs/tables/` and `outputs/R6G_validation_summary.xlsx`.

## Algorithm and Parameter Settings Summary

- Cosmic-ray removal: 4 methods compared, `modified_zscore` selected.
- Baseline correction: 6 methods compared, `ALS` selected.
- Smoothing: 5 methods compared, `Gaussian` selected.
- Normalization: max (for DFT comparability); vector/area/SNV/TIC also reported.
- Peak fitting: lmfit, best-of-{Gaussian, Lorentzian, PseudoVoigt, Voigt} per peak by reduced chi-square; 20 cm-1 fit window.
- Rayleigh-line mask: |shift| < 100 cm-1.
- Low-frequency DFT intensity cutoff: 100 cm-1.
- Hungarian assignment cost threshold: 15 cm-1.
- Scaling factor grid search: s in [0.94, 1.00], 61 steps; bootstrap n=300, seed=42.
- Broadening line-shape selection: AIC/BIC across Gaussian/Lorentzian/Voigt/PseudoVoigt; selected shape = `Lorentzian`.
- Bootstrap statistics: n=2000 resamples, seed=42.
- Bond perception (PED): Pyykko & Atsumi (2009) covalent radii, 1.3x tolerance, 67 bonds identified.
